events.verdict: Sheppard (IND) establishes himself in White's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
Nembhard (IND) is bracing for the contact from Hauser (BOS) and he releases away from the contact as he changes direction.
There is no clear or conclusive video evidence that shows if Nembhard's (IND) foot touches the sideline out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Queta (BOS) secures the rebound and inadvertently lands on Sheppard's (IND) foot, and the contact is incidental.
Queta (BOS) firms up over his right leg in Sheppard's (IND) path prior to the contact.
Sheppard (IND) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Huff (IND) and Queta (BOS) mutually engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

Queta (BOS) cleanly block Nembhard's (IND) shot attempt.  White (BOS) maintains verticality and the contact that occurs with Nembhard after the shot is blocked is considered incidental.  Walsh (BOS) also avoids making any contact with Nembhard during his shot attempt.
Huff (IND) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Pritchard's (BOS) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) cleanly blocks Pritchard's (BOS) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
White (BOS) legally contests Nembhard's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Sheppard (IND) and Queta (BOS) deflect the ball away from one another as they pursue the rebound.
Nesmith (IND) maintains a legal guarding position alongside White's (BOS) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) is late to establish a screening position in White's (BOS) path and does not give him the time or distance to change direction and avoid the contact during the pick.
Siakam (IND) brings his left arm toward White's (BOS) side during his spin move, and the contact is marginal.
White (BOS) legally contests Siakam's (IND) shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Pritchard (BOS).
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that there is illegal contact by Walker (IND) during White's (BOS) upward shooting motion
Siakam (IND) and Scheierman (BOS) come together at the same spot and incidental foot-to-foot contact occurs as they pursue the rebound.
Nesmith (IND) applies his arm to Hauser's (BOS) body as they run alongside each other towards the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
